why: Compares role and nothing else of the nine attributes the owner ruled on. role is the one everybody remembers; aria-label, aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are what give a control its name and description, and aria-pressed, aria-expanded and aria-current carry its state. A toggle whose aria-pressed stopped updating, or a panel that lost the aria-labelledby that names it, would pass the required check. The per-attribute cases are spelled out literally so each one dies on its own name.
